analyst_view.overall: Early view: a relegation game between two clubs with new coaches. Leganés (18th) appointed Luis Carrión in October to replace Rubén Albés and had not won since 20 September; Ceuta (22nd, 5 pts, 30 conceded) replaced José Juan Romero with Sergio Lobera on 8 November after a 3-0 loss at Córdoba. Francisco Montero's ban from the brief should be served long before this match.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.7 goals. Ceuta have the worst defence in the league but Leganés have scored only 11 all season, so I stay with the number.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.7 corners. Leganés had nearly two-thirds of the ball against Albacete, which fits the figure, and nothing else points either way.

cards.text: The numbers say 6.3 cards. A direct relegation game between two sides at the bottom, both trying to show a reaction for new coaches, makes me lean slightly higher.

shots.text: The numbers say 29.2 shots. Leganés took 17 shots against Albacete and Ceuta concede plenty, so a high total fits and I stay with it.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.5 shots on target. Leganés's finishing, led by Álvaro Morata, has been poor, which offsets Ceuta's weak defence, so I stay with the number.
